about: Load a save made with 14 mods (3 modded cells, 28 modded prisoners) with NO mods installed. GNX's sanitize pass must replace the orphaned content instead of crashing: every cell and unit points at registered content, no prisoner is lost, followers are attached, and the cleaned nest survives normal play plus a save/reload.
